--- AST

  Name: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{

        NameEnd: 23,
        Name:    "sch",
      },
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 24,
        NameEnd: 25,
        Name:    "G",
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
DROP PROPERTY GRAPH sch.G
